artworks.title: Study after Gozzoli
artworks.medium: graphite and colored pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person in profile view carrying a child on their back. The adult figure is slightly bent forward, supporting the child who is looking towards the viewer. The adult has short, slightly wavy hair, wears a cap, and seems concentrated. They wear a knee-length pleated garment. The child has curly hair and a neutral expression, with one hand on the adult's shoulder. The background has lightly sketched figures indicating other people or a lively setting, but lacks detail. The image is set on a plain background with no distinct environmental features.

artworks.title: Study of Hunter with Dogs
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing in profile view, facing to the right. The person has a casual stance with one leg slightly bent, facial features indicated with simple lines, and is wearing a hat and simple clothing. One arm is bent at the waist, holding a staff, and two dogs are drawn near their legs. The background is textured, indicating a rough sketch without additional details.

artworks.title: Study of a Girl Reading
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woman in profile view, seated on a short stool. She has a neat bun hairstyle and wears a long dress with lace details. She is holding an object that resembles a small box or book. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study of a Girl's Head
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and partial neck, with delicate facial features indicating a serene expression. The person's head is slightly tilted to the side and looking downward. The hairstyle is an elegant updo, with the hair neatly swept back and possibly braided. The person is wearing a high-collared garment, and there are no visible signs of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain, unadorned sheet of paper, with some slight discoloration.

artworks.title: Students in the Latin Quarter, Paris
artworks.medium: graphite and red colored pencil on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated and reclining on a cushioned surface. One man is seated, wearing a hat and a loose-fitting suit, with his head slightly tilted downward. The other man is reclined with one arm on his knee and the other behind him for support. Both men have short hair and facial hair. Additional details in the image include a large open trunk, bottles on the ground, a hanging fabric or garment by a doorway, and a simple interior column to the left.

artworks.title: Rome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of an ancient stone archway, viewed from a slightly off-center position. The horizon is not visible. The stone blocks that make up the arch are depicted with visible pencil strokes indicating texture and solidity, with shadowing under the arch. A variation in pencil pressure creates darker contours and lighter shading for surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey to represent the stone and light and shadow effects. The balance between solid forms of the stones and softer background elements like foliage or rough surfaces is delicate. In the bottom right corner, the notation "Rome 1857" provides location and date information.

artworks.title: Tuscany
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape sketch with a dilapidated building in the center and a structure with a conical roof to its right. In the background, there are low hills, vegetation, and a rugged terrain. The sketch is detailed, textured, and monochromatic, with fine pen strokes outlining the scene.

artworks.title: The Son and the Donkey
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a vintage sketch showing three figures: a man, a child, and a donkey. The man, child, and donkey are depicted in different postures, with the man standing higher than the child. The man has a beard and curly hair, wearing a tunic and trousers. The child is barefoot and interacts with the donkey, gently touching its nose. The donkey stands calmly with its head down. In the background, there is an archway showing a brighter outdoor scene. The sketch is detailed with cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Son and Donkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in a classical setting. The sketch is composed of several figures, some carrying objects on their heads and others engaging in communal activities. It depicts a scene of daily life, with some figures positioned around a bench or platform. There is a roughly sketched animal in the foreground. The drawing is done in a loose, expressive style, capturing movement and atmosphere. The use of shading suggests depth and indicates darker areas.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Miller and the Donkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with various figures and a donkey. The image showcases a group of people in a town setting, with architectural elements and a path leading through an avenue of trees. In the foreground, there is a person riding a donkey, while in the background, other figures stand or walk, some dressed in flowing garments. The composition is rendered in pencil, capturing a sense of movement and depth through the use of shading and simple line work.

artworks.title: Father and Son
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring individuals and animals in a rural setting. The scene includes several figures, with two central figures standing prominently. A donkey is depicted in the midground, moving towards a group of structures in the distance. Faint architectural outlines can be seen in the background. The drawing is done in pencil or charcoal, giving it a loose and sketchy quality. The composition conveys a sense of movement and narrative within a pastoral environment.

artworks.title: Father and Son
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene showing multiple figures in a historical setting. Closest to the viewer, several individuals are gathered, with one woman extending a cup to another woman, while two other women sit nearby. To the left, a path leads up a hill where two men are walking, one holding a staff, and a donkey is seen nearby. In the middle distance, a landscape with small trees and rolling hills is visible. The sketch is done in pencil with fluid lines and shading, conveying motion and interaction. The artwork utilizes a monochrome palette with soft contrasts and gentle shading.

artworks.title: Son and Donkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a rural scene. It shows several figures, some riding a donkey, with buildings and architectural elements in the background. The sketch is done with loose pencil brushstrokes in various shades of grey on light beige paper.

artworks.title: Father, Son, and Donkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate scenes involving figures riding a horse. The top portion of the drawing features two figures riding a horse, depicted with fluid motion using loose, flowing lines. The figures are roughly drawn with minimal detailing. The bottom portion shows a solitary rider on horseback with another figure walking beside the horse. The drawing uses simple lines and shading to suggest movement and companionship, with an emphasis on shape and posture rather than detailed features. The technique appears swift and spontaneous, suggesting a study or quick capturing of motion and form.

artworks.title: Village Scene
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in an outdoor scene. The drawing depicts a group of shapes resembling human figures in various poses. Some figures are standing while others are crouched or leaning. The pencil lines are faint and preliminary, capturing the basic forms and poses without specific details or features. To the right, there are outlines of structures and possibly boats, suggesting a waterside setting. The minimalistic approach gives the impression of an artist's early compositional sketch, focusing mainly on layout and movement rather than refined detail. The drawing conveys a sense of motion and interaction within a simple, undefined landscape.

artworks.title: Son and the Donkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a group of figures. On the left side, there are three figures partially obscured, potentially standing, and wearing long garments or cloaks. Faces are not detailed, with emphasis on their clothing. On the right, a single figure is bending over, using a cane or stick for support and wearing a shorter garment. The background is shaded with sketches hinting at other figures or a landscape but lacks specific detail. The scene maintains focus on the central figures with a backdrop of loosely drawn lines and shading.

artworks.title: Ground Floor Plan for Torre Quatro Venti
artworks.medium: pen and ink and colored pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ground floor plan. The floor plan is hand-drawn on paper and depicts the layout of a building's ground floor, including various rooms and features. The drawing includes labels for different areas such as the "kitchen," "pantry," "dining-room," "library or spare bedroom," "hall," "drawing-room," and "servant bed-room." Additionally, there are annotations marking features like "going up to olives," "against hill slope," and "pine trees below." The rooms are outlined with lines, and some areas are filled in with color, indicating different zones or functions. There are arrows and additional handwritten notes providing further details about the connections between these spaces. The drawing offers a detailed insight into the architectural design and spatial layout of this particular ground floor area.

artworks.title: Orte
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rugged terrain. The horizon is near the top of the composition, with distant mountains under an overcast sky. Delicate, sketch-like brushstrokes create a soft texture on boulders and vegetation. The color palette includes browns, beiges, greens, and muted blues. Large rocks, sparse vegetation, and a small building with a slanted roof are in the foreground. Ancient-looking structures are visible in the distance on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Shipwreck
artworks.medium: charcoal, watercolor, and gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene from an elevated point of view. Three boats are navigating rough waters: two small rowing boats with figures and a larger ship in the distance. The horizon blends into the overcast sky with dramatic clouds. The brushstrokes are expressive and loose, capturing the dynamic movement of waves and sky. The color palette is subdued with grays, blues, and white for the frothy water, conveying stormy weather.

artworks.title: Roman Landscape
artworks.medium: colored chalks on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, dividing the sky from the land. The landscape includes hills, mountains, a river or stream, foliage, and trees. The sketch is created with loose brushstrokes using pencil and pastel. Earthy tones, grays, and white chalk are used for a subdued color palette. A road or path winds through the center, enhancing depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Fragment from a Wall in Capri
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fragment of a sculptural relief. The image shows a sketch of a section of architectural or sculptural stonework that includes a horse in profile and draped fabric. The drawing is executed in pencil or charcoal on a neutral paper, emphasizing the textures and curves of the stone's relief with shading. Some handwriting in Italian, possibly notes by the artist, is visible alongside the image.

artworks.title: Arco Oscuro--Over the Via Fiaminia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The pencil drawing features a tree-lined path leading towards a dome structure in the distance. The horizon is high, with the dome and a smaller structure below it dominating the skyline. The sketchy and loose brushstrokes give the scene movement and texture. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of gray on off-white paper. The path is flanked by dense trees on the left and shaded foliage on the right, creating depth and directing the viewer towards the structures.

artworks.title: From the Rubáiyát
artworks.medium: graphite, black and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of a person lying face down on a flat surface. The person's body is leaning forward, arms extended outward. The head is partially visible, with short textured and slightly curly hair. They are wearing a loose garment with visible folds. The right arm is outstretched with slightly bent fingers. The background is plain. Shading and white highlights emphasize the body and fabric contours.

artworks.title: Detail of the Marriage of the Daughter of the Vine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural column with an ornate top decorated with fantastical elements. The column twists upwards and ends in a intricately designed top with a shell-like scroll element. In the curve is a small figure or creature. A stylized wing or feather motif extends from the figure. Above them, a small burning lamp emits rays of light. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketchy style using dark lines on a light background.
